extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers using IAR/eRA Commons (assigned and unassigned reviewers expected to submit critiques and preliminary scores)
extracted.subtask_description: Step‑by‑step operational instructions for reviewers to prepare, locate, upload, manage, and delete Microsoft Word critique templates and preliminary scores in the IAR module of eRA Commons during the Submit and Edit phases of a review meeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit critiques and scores during Submit and Edit phases in IAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers have to submit critiques and scores electronically for assigned applications during the Submit and Edit phases in IAR. Reviewers may also submit critiques and scores for applications that they are not assigned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is required during the specific meeting phases (Submit and Edit). The page notes reviewers can submit for unassigned applications as well. If reviewers have questions, contact your SRO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-meeting conflict of interest (COI) certification required
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers will be unable to submit critiques and scores if they have not signed their pre-meeting conflict of interest certification in IAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An alert will notify reviewers and they must click the link to certify the pre-meeting COI before they can submit critiques and scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Microsoft Word critique templates (doc/docx only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Word documents (doc, docx) can be uploaded; PDFs cannot be uploaded as critiques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critiques must be prepared on the Microsoft Word critique templates provided. Attempting to upload PDFs will not work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locating and downloading Word critique templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Microsoft Word templates can be found in IAR’s meeting materials folder, or by clicking on the application's 'Critique Template' link on the List of All Applications screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers can also download all critique templates for all applications specifically assigned to them by using the zip file link on the List of My Assigned Applications or List of All Applications screens. See the 'Reviewers: Locating Critique Template link in IAR' help page. If you have questions, contact your SRO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be logged into IAR via eRA Commons with appropriate roles
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be logged into IAR via eRA Commons with appropriate role(s) to complete these activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Without the necessary eRA Commons roles and a logged‑in session, you cannot access the meeting materials or submit/edit critiques and scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing the Submit Critique and Preliminary Score screen
rubrics_metrics.description: The submit link is accessed by clicking the three‑dot ellipses icon in the Role column on the List of My Assigned Applications screen and choosing the 'Submit Critique' option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: That link takes the reviewer to the 'Submit Critique and Preliminary Score' screen. Note screenshots and exact UI may vary depending on meeting configuration and phase; contact your SRO for clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to delete scores and critiques
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions are provided for how to delete scores and critiques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deletion functionality exists (and may require being in the appropriate meeting phase and logged in). Follow the page's step‑by‑step instructions or contact your SRO for help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow NIH scoring system and Additional Scoring Guidance documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitters should use the NIH Scoring System and Procedure and the Additional Scoring Guidance documents for applying scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to 'NIH Scoring System and Procedure (PDF)', 'Additional Scoring Guidance for NIH Research Applications (PDF)', and 'NIH Additional Scoring Guidance: Applications for Fellowships, Career Awards, and Institutional Training Grants (PDF)'. Reviewers should consult those documents for substantive scoring criteria and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use available tutorials and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: A video tutorial ('Reviewers: Submitting Critiques and Preliminary Scores') is available to walk reviewers through submitting critiques and preliminary scores in IAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The tutorial (4:11 minutes) and linked help pages provide step‑by‑step instructions and screenshots; use them if uncertain about the process. Contact your SRO for questions not covered by the materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Screenshots and UI variability notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Screenshots may vary depending on the meeting configuration and meeting phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect visual differences in menus and screens; rely on the described workflow (three‑dot ellipses → Submit Critique) and contact your SRO if the interface differs significantly.
